crew.overview: The remarkable story of Brazilian racing driver Ayrton Senna, charting his physical and spiritual achievements on the track and off, his quest for perfection, and the mythical status he has since attained, is the subject of Senna, a documentary feature that spans the racing legend's years as an F1 driver, from his opening season in 1984 to his untimely death a decade later.
crew.title: Senna

crew.overview: In the 1970s, a rivalry propels race car drivers Niki Lauda and James Hunt to fame and glory — until a horrible accident threatens to end it all.
crew.title: Rush

details.biography:
Matt Bishop, born on December 25, 1962, in London, is a British motorsport journalist and communications expert. As editor of F1 Racing magazine from 1996 to 2007, he made it one of the leading publications in Formula 1. In 2008, he joined McLaren Racing as Chief Communications Officer, working with drivers like Lewis Hamilton and Jenson Button. Later, he became Communications Director for the all-female W Series, promoting diversity in motorsport. In 2020, he joined Aston Martin’s F1 team as Chief Communications Officer. Bishop is also a founder ambassador of Racing Pride, advocating for LGBTQ+ inclusivity in motorsport.

Bishop's extensive experience and dedication have made him a respected figure in the motorsport community, known for his advocacy of diversity and his contributions to the sport's media and communications landscape.
details.name: Matt Bishop
